key_insight: SOTA turns the option-trading problem into strategy-level decisions, letting an agent choose among option structures while deterministic modules build the actual portfolio.
engineering_relevance: This reduces the combinatorial complexity of options trading and makes large-model agents more practical for adaptive, market-regime-aware strategy selection.
method: Post-train Qwen3.8-27B with supervised fine-tuning, then reinforcement learning.
Abstract the huge option contract space into a smaller set of strategy choices.
Use deterministic resolvers to convert selected strategies into executable option portfolios.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on options for nine large-cap U.S. equities plus SPY over a six-month out-of-sample period, achieving 18.3% total return, a 1.60 Sharpe ratio, and 8.96% maximum drawdown.
watch_item: News appears helpful in supervised/frontier-teacher stages but harmful during reinforcement learning, so feature inclusion must be carefully staged to avoid severe out-of-sample degradation.
paper_title: SOTA: Stock Options Trading Agents Guided by Option-Implied Return Distributions
